A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the decision problems of the homomorphic preimages of the classes of digraph with a given number of arcs, with given number of vertices, and with a given number or arcs per vertex belong to the class ${\rm NP} \cap {\rm coNP}$.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the forbidden preimages of oriented cycles are not necessarily the same as those of the corresponding undirected graphs.
, for the classes of digraph homomorphisms to oriented cycles, the characterization of forbidden preimages is a useful tool to prove complexity results.
